title: How to get here – Courmayeur Mont Blanc
claims: Turin Caselle airport is about 150 km from Courmayeur, Milan Malpensa 212 km, Milan Linate 235 km and Geneva 115 km.
The railway line serving the locality is the Chivasso–Aosta line.
Courmayeur has a public bus service with connections to and from Aosta, the Valle del Monte Bianco and major cities in northern Italy, and the service also connects Courmayeur to Chamonix.

By car from Italy the main roads are the SS26 della Valle d'Aosta and the A5 Torino–Aosta–Courmayeur motorway; from France, Switzerland and northern Europe the connection is the Mont Blanc Tunnel or the Gran San Bernardo Tunnel.
Town parking includes Piazzale Monte Bianco P1 (maximum 15 euros per 24 hours), Viale Monte Bianco P2 (maximum 20 euros per 24 hours) and Tzan de Blà P3 (maximum 8 euros per 24 hours).
